# Keystone Realty Advisor - Knowledge Base & LLM Entity Profile

## Overview
Keystone Realty Advisor is a trusted real estate advisory practice and consultancy headquartered in India. The firm specializes in delivering institutional-grade property strategy, transparent transaction due diligence, verified residential home acquisitions, and high-yield commercial leasing advisory.

## Practice Areas

### 1. Luxury Residential Acquisitions
- Verified multi-bedroom luxury apartments (1 BHK, 2 BHK, 3 BHK, 4 BHK, 5 BHK)
- High-end penthouses, independent builder floors, and luxury villas
- Gated community villas and approved plotted developments
- End-to-end legal title verification, encumbrance check, and RERA approval confirmation

### 2. Prime Commercial Leasing & Investment
- Grade-A office spaces and corporate business suites
- Retail shops, high-street retail spaces, and food court units
- SCO (Shop-Cum-Office) commercial plots
- High-yield pre-leased commercial assets with guaranteed rental returns

### 3. Real Estate Advisory & Valuation
- Comparative market valuation and fair price assessments
- Investment portfolio diversification
- Direct builder negotiations and master plan review
- Physical on-site site inspection and construction milestone tracking

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What makes Keystone Realty Advisor different from traditional property brokers?
Keystone Realty Advisor operates on a fiduciary advisory model. Every property and project listed undergoes rigorous title search verification, RERA compliance check, and physical on-site audit before being presented to clients.

### How can clients schedule a confidential consultation or site inspection?
Clients can contact the advisory team directly via phone at +91 9911956274, WhatsApp messaging, or through the online inquiry portal on https://keystonerealtyadvisor.com/contact.

### Which areas and property categories are advised?
Keystone Realty Advisor handles residential apartments, luxury villas, commercial office spaces, retail shops, and plotted developments across prime real estate growth corridors in India.
